name: janela

scripts.bootstrap: bun install && bun run generate && bun run build:native
scripts.test: turbo run test -- --pass-with-no-tests && bun test scripts
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings && oxfmt --check . && bun run check:layers && bun run check:fsd
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
